incident_text: Heavy smoke is rising behind a farm and a house stands close to the smoke. We think a wildfire is coming toward the house.

result.scene_summary: A large, dark, swirling storm cloud dominates the sky over a rural landscape with trees and houses, suggesting an approaching severe weather event.

observations.description: Large plumes of dark, dense smoke rising from the ground on the right side of the image, suggesting a fire or explosion.
A dark line of coniferous trees along the horizon, with other trees and shrubs scattered in the foreground and midground.
A single-family house with a visible porch and roof, partially obscured by smoke and trees on the right.
A vast, dark, turbulent cloud formation occupying the upper portion of the frame, indicating severe weather.
